productLossClosed: The flat thread-centric sidebar is now the default on every build channel.
The original project-tree sidebar remains available as Settings > General > Legacy features > Sidebar (legacy).
Web and Lynx use one legacySidebarEnabled preference instead of the retired channel-dependent Sidebar v2 beta keys.
Lynx Settings now owns one bounded 768px scroll viewport at 1280x820, so the Legacy features section can be reached and expanded.
The Legacy feature row renders full-width instead of collapsing into a horizontal split.
harnessLoss: The original sidebar-project-groups capture compared draft selectedProject projections even though the authoritative project rows already matched; the focused gate now uses row titles and geometry.
The original flat-sidebar captures inherited transcript, Composer, Header, and provider-notification gates unrelated to sidebar layout; sidebar-flat-layout now verifies the focused layout contract.

Lynx DevTool measured touch does not currently scroll the Native Settings scroll-view, so Native Legacy-toggle mutation remains pending a physical wheel/touch session. Browser dual-renderer evidence proves the real wheel, pointer expansion, preference-backed layout selection, and reverse layout availability.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Internal implementation classes retain the sidebar-v2 prefix for migration stability, while the user-visible product model is flat versus legacy.
Web and Lynx can resolve different active draft projects in empty-thread fixtures; focused sidebar identity uses visible controls, rows, and layout version.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Legacy project rows measure approximately 237x31.7 on Web and 239x32 on Lynx-for-Web.
The Legacy settings row measures 896x85.7 on Web and 896x84 on Lynx-for-Web.
Native text rasterization, stage artwork, and switch material remain platform-specific.
